name: Black Thunder Water Theme Park
brand: Black Thunder Theme Park Private Limited

location.address: Jaganari Slopes R.F., Ooty Main Road, Mettupalayam, Tamil Nadu - 641305, India
location.starting_point_of_railway: Mettupalayam Railway Station (Nilgiri Mountain Railway starting junction is ~4 km away)

operating_hours.notes: Open every single day year-round amidst Nilgiri foothill mountain views.

combos_and_adventure.adventure_criteria: Minimum height: 145 cm | Maximum weight: 85 kg

student_and_group_rules.student_concession_min_group: Minimum 20 students from same school/college with valid institutional bonafide letter.
student_and_group_rules.complimentary_staff: 1 staff member entry is complimentary for every 15 paying students (with valid staff ID).
student_and_group_rules.senior_id: Senior citizens (60+ years) must produce valid government photo ID.

dress_code_policy.water_park: Nylon or synthetic swimwear is strictly mandatory across all 30 water rides. Sarees, jeans, cotton track pants, dhotis, and innerwear are strictly prohibited in the water.
dress_code_policy.sales_and_rental: Costumes and swimwear are readily available for rent and sale inside the park changing facilities.

amenities_and_facilities.lockers: Safe digital/key locker rentals available in men's and women's changing pavilions.
amenities_and_facilities.food_policy: Outside food and alcoholic beverages strictly not allowed inside theme park.
amenities_and_facilities.accommodations: AVANA Resort (on-site 4-star resort with 40+ deluxe rooms, suites, swimming pool, and conference facilities).
amenities_and_facilities.event_lawns: 3 grand open-air wedding and corporate lawns accommodating up to 3,000 guests, plus 2 indoor ballrooms (200 capacity each).
amenities_and_facilities.lake_activities: Natural lake with pedal boating and fish pond.

dining_venues.name: Thunder Cafe
dining_venues.cuisine: Authentic South Indian thalis, Chettinad specialties, North Indian cuisine, and Chinese favorites with floor-to-ceiling panoramic glass windows.

dining_venues.name: Tusker Bar
dining_venues.offerings: Fine wines, beers, cocktails, mocktails, fish fingers, tandoori kebabs, and Chinese platters.

dining_venues.name: Bamboo Huts
dining_venues.ambience: Authentic hut seating with mountain breezes and coconut tree grove canopy.

dining_venues.name: BBQ & Bonfire
dining_venues.features: Grills and bonfires set on grassy lawns under the stars at AVANA Resort.

dining_venues.name: Picnic By The Fountain
dining_venues.offerings: Quick bites, ice creams, seasonal beverages, and family picnic combos.

water_rides.name: Wave Pool
water_rides.description: One of India's largest artificial wave pools creating 1.5m ocean surf waves.

water_rides.name: Wild River / Lazy River
water_rides.description: Slow, relaxing drift tube channel snaking through greenery.

water_rides.name: Spider Slide
water_rides.description: Radial tube slides dropping into central catch pool.

water_rides.name: Bowl Slide
water_rides.description: Enclosed chute leading into centrifugal bowl spin before deep plunge.

water_rides.name: Boomerang Slide
water_rides.description: High-adrenaline raft ascent and descent on steep vertical walls.

water_rides.name: Downhill Rapid Slide
water_rides.description: Multi-stage racing chute with thrilling dips.

water_rides.name: Cannon Ball
water_rides.description: High velocity water shoot that launches riders into the air.

water_rides.name: Speed Slide (24ft & 36ft Free Fall)
water_rides.description: Steep near-vertical freefall slides for extreme adrenaline.

water_rides.name: Surf Hill
water_rides.description: Multi-lane undulating slide where riders race face-first on mats.

water_rides.name: Thunder Rain
water_rides.description: High-energy dance floor with monsoon misting jets and music.

water_rides.name: Family Raft
water_rides.description: Oversized round raft navigating deep twists and turns.

water_rides.name: New Kids Pool & Family Playstation
water_rides.description: Shallow water zone with mini tipping buckets and safe slides.

dry_rides.name: Columbus
dry_rides.description: Dragon-themed roller coaster speeding through palm groves.

dry_rides.name: Family Coaster
dry_rides.description: Gentle drops and turns tailored for children and parents.

dry_rides.name: Ferris Wheel
dry_rides.description: Panoramic vista of the Nilgiri Hills foothills.

adventure_and_extreme_activities.name: Zipline Coaster
adventure_and_extreme_activities.description: Glide across park canopy on high-tension cables.

adventure_and_extreme_activities.name: Zipline Cycle
adventure_and_extreme_activities.description: Pedal a bicycle suspended high above the ground on a wire.

adventure_and_extreme_activities.name: Bungee Ejection
adventure_and_extreme_activities.description: Catapulted skyward from ground level under extreme acceleration.

adventure_and_extreme_activities.name: Wall Climbing & Tyre Wall Climbing
adventure_and_extreme_activities.description: Challenging artificial rock wall and vertical tyre obstacles.

adventure_and_extreme_activities.name: Cargo Net & Burma Bridge
adventure_and_extreme_activities.description: Military-style suspension bridge and rope traverses.

nature_and_resort_activities.name: Pedal Boating
nature_and_resort_activities.description: Pedal boat rentals on calm scenic waters.

nature_and_resort_activities.name: Bird Park & Animal Watch Tower
nature_and_resort_activities.description: Walkway for bird sightings and wildlife observation.

nature_and_resort_activities.name: Cycling Track
nature_and_resort_activities.description: Half-kilometer scenic trail running along sports grounds.

nature_and_resort_activities.name: Early Morning Animal Interaction Walk
nature_and_resort_activities.description: Interactions with rabbits, turtles, chickens, and exotic birds.
